routing_summary.note: Fixed learners, penalties and budgets. No selection using dev targets. Three independent base fits produce training labels; no official holdout.

neighbors.descriptor: Within-tissue covariance with 16 RNA PCs of 1024 training-variable genes; association, not causality
neighbors.controls: 5 nearest vs mean of 20 sets of 5 random loci, matched context/region/TSS quartile; all neighbors >=1Mb away; train-patient associations transfer to held-out patients

structure_summary.note: Means/SD labels use training patients for probe fit and held-out patients for evaluation. Context/region already enter hybrid branches; their decoding is not independent validation.

latency_summary.note: Resident inputs/weights, shared GPU, no disk I/O or gate fitting/bag assembly. Three conditions: no factors cached, CpG factors cached, both RNA/CpG factors cached. Routing uses two independent RNA encoders when patient factors are not cached and both routes are populated.

diagnostic_summary.note: Post-hoc target SD groups and target means are diagnostic only. Errors are averaged across seeds before descriptive per-CpG medians; these medians differ from the mean of seed-level medians.

gated.note: Soft capacity gate; the deep branch is always evaluated.

prototype.note: Soft prototypes with residual response; factors are not identifiable biological programs.

training_protocol.scope: internal development only; no official holdout evaluation

analysis_protocol.gate_targets: OOF cheap MSE minus deep MSE, mean over seeds
analysis_protocol.uniform_selection: minimum mean inner-fold MSE; tie fewer steps then depth
analysis_protocol.probes: fixed ridge alpha100; train-locus scaler only
analysis_protocol.neighbors: 5 nearest vs 20 matched random sets, >=1Mb, matched context/region/TSS quartile
analysis_protocol.uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap genomic-block draws; seed means; no patient bootstrap
analysis_protocol.status: frozen before any pilot evaluation inspected
